steps.en: Copy lawfully obtained game folders to the documented location, then launch the installed game
steps.zh: 复制合法取得的游戏资源到文档位置，再启动游戏

steps.en: Open base resources and available expansion data
steps.zh: 打开基础资源及已有的扩展版数据

steps.en: Choose a scenario from the game menu
steps.zh: 在游戏菜单里选择关卡

steps.en: Run Heroes II gameplay with replacement interface and opponent logic
steps.zh: 用重写的界面和电脑对手逻辑运行二代玩法

value.en: Replay your Heroes II content with a maintained engine instead of the original executable
value.zh: 用持续维护的引擎重玩二代内容，不再依赖原版程序
